name: caption-room
description: Free, open live captions you can share with a room code. A successor to Web Captioner's sharing feature.

scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @caption-room/web && npm run dev -w @caption-room/worker
scripts.build:relay: npm run build -w @caption-room/web && cargo build --release --manifest-path relay/Cargo.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @caption-room/web && npm run deploy -w @caption-room/worker
